name: FPP Game Scheduler
author: Dale Peterson
description: Sync ESPN team schedules to FPP playlists with optional dry-run and date lookahead.

privacy.summary: Fetches game schedules from ESPN APIs and updates this FPP instance schedule.
systemChanges: Writes schedule entries through the local FPP API endpoint.
privacy.other: Outbound network access to ESPN API hosts is required.
